label: Every cause of another thing's being is a CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred (weak sustaining reading of the tenseless cause of being): in every history of the model, if c, distinct from x, causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) and x is present at some moment, then c gives x being at every moment at which x is present (CAUSE_OF_BEING_2, SustainsBeing). The restriction of 'Every cause of a thing's being is a CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 sustaining cause of it' (23e04ae5) to causes distinct from their effect: entailed by it (registered strength order), strictly weaker (Control part 5: a self-cause that gives nothing). It is all the immensity presence step uses, since the creator conjunct of IMMENSE_2 concerns every other being. Derived from concurrent actualization (weak), the reception bridge da72ae93 and concurrence of causes of being. Contested by existential inertia (Schmid 2021, read) through the concurrent-actualization premise.
